# One row per app per reading point; copied by hand from the ID-CENSUS lines the named test prints (tests never write the tree).
# next_id: NEXT_ID by a NON-consuming scan of get_layout(0..512), cross-checked by one consuming register_new at the end of each process.
# next_resource_id: by one CONSUMING probe per point, corrected for the census's own earlier probes. pinned / lowest_pinned: register_layout slots above the first gap.

#   playground_composition = EnginePlugins + FlyCameraPlugin + PhysicsPlugin (composition, NOT the scene: setup is private to the example); demo = a replica of DemoApp::new's world half.
